cues.text:
I had learned to keep on moving
With my eyes upon the shore

Holding tightly to the things
That I trusted in before

Then You met me where I stood
The work still in my hands

Jesus, You said, “Follow Me”
Before I knew the road You planned

You know my name
You know my heart

You have found me
Where I am

I turn toward You
Take one step

Leave the shore;
follow Your plan

You are calling
Calling
Jesus, You are calling me

You are calling
Calling
And I'll follow where You lead

You know my name
I hear Your voice
You have taken hold of me

You are calling
Calling
Jesus, let it be.

Not because I earned Your favor
Not because my hands were clean

By Your Grace, by Your mercy
They do not stand between.

There are things I cannot carry
There are nets I have to leave

But the One who stands before me
Is the One who first loved me

You know my name
You know my heart

You have found me
Where I am

I turn toward You
Take one step

Leave the shore;
follow Your plan

You are calling
Calling
Jesus, You are calling me

You are calling
Calling
And I'll follow where You lead

You know my name
I hear Your voice
You have taken hold of me

You are calling
Calling
Jesus, let it be.

I do not know
Each turn ahead

But I know You
And what You said

You give me life
You call me Yours

I hear Your voice
And leave the shore

Jesus
I will follow You
